title: High Court Notification No.C.3005/2024 dated 18.01.2025
text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
NOTIFICATION No. C.3005/2024
All the Advocates and their clerks concerned are requested to
take note that under Rule 7 of the Commissioner of Oaths for the High
Court of Gujarat Rules, 2024, Mr. Dilipkumar Samrathdan Gadhvi,
Advocate, has been empowered to function and perform duties as
Commissioner of Oaths for the High Court.
His Office address is :
Chamber No. 2036 (In care of Mr. Darshan Dave),
New Advocate Building, Gujarat High Court Campus, High Court of
Gujarat, Sola, Ahmedabad.
He make his services available during court hours at the Bar
Room in the High Court.
High Court of Gujarat, By Order
Sola, Ahmedabad-380 060.
ae a
Date: January /9 , 2025 Registrar General
Copy forwarded with compliments to :-
1) Mr. Dilipkumar Samrathdan Gadhvi, Advocate, High Court of
Gujarat (By letter)
2) The Registrar Judicial), High Court of Gujarat.
3) The President, Gujarat High Court Advocates’ Association,
Ahmedabad. (By letter)
4) ‘The President, Advocates’ Clerks Association, Gujarat High
Court Building, Anmedabad. (By letter)
5) The Manager, Government Central Press, Gandhinagar.
(for a favor of publication in Part- ‘TV-C’ of the next issue of the
Gujarat Government Gazette) (By letter)
6) Notice Board.
